Class PosGUI

java.lang.Object
PosGUI
public class PosGUI extends Object
Boba shop point-of-sale GUI with a Cashier view for taking orders and a Manager view for reports, inventory, employees and menu items.
Author:
Aaron DallaRosa, Joyce You, Ansen Basil, Matthew Shi

      private static String paymentDialog(Component owner, double total)
      Shows a dialog asking how the customer is paying.

      owner - the component the dialog is centered over
      total - the order total shown in the dialog

    • cashierDialog

      private static int cashierDialog(Component owner, Object content, String title, String[] options)
      Shows a dialog in the cashier style with a button for each option.
      Parameters:
      owner - the component the dialog is centered over
      content - a component to show, or any other object to show as text
      title - the dialog title
      options - the button labels, left to right
      Returns:
      the index of the button clicked, or -1 if the dialog was closed

      private static void cashierStyle(Component component)
      Applies the black-and-white cashier style to a component and all of its children. Selected buttons turn black, and tables get black selections.
      Parameters:
      component - the component to style

    • customizeDrink

      private static boolean customizeDrink(Component owner, DefaultTableModel menu, int row, DefaultTableModel toppings, DefaultTableModel cart, List<int[]> cartIds, int edit)
      Shows the drink options dialog for quantity, sweetness, toppings, ice and size, then adds the drink to the cart or updates an existing cart line.
      Parameters:
      owner - the component the dialog is centered over
      menu - the menu table model
      row - the menu row of the drink
      toppings - the toppings table model
      cart - the cart table model
      cartIds - for each cart line, the menu item id followed by its topping ids
      edit - the cart line to edit, or -1 to add a new drink
      Returns:
      true if the cart changed, false if the cashier cancelled

    • choiceButtons

      private static JPanel choiceButtons(ButtonGroup group, String[] choices, String selected)
      Creates a grid of toggle buttons where only one can be selected.
      Parameters:
      group - the button group the buttons are added to
      choices - the button labels, also used as their action commands
      selected - the choice that starts selected
      Returns:
      the panel holding the buttons

    • nextId

      private static int nextId(String table, String column) throws SQLException
      Finds the next unused id in a table. The seed data inserted ids directly, so the database sequences are behind and can't be used.
      Parameters:
      table - the table to look in
      column - the id column of that table
      Returns:
      one more than the largest id in the table, or 1 if it is empty
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the query fails

    • reportColumns

      private static String[] reportColumns(String report)
      Gets the column headers for a report. The columns and SQL for each report are kept in matching switch statements so a report name is the single key needed to find both.
      Parameters:
      report - a report name from REPORT_NAMES
      Returns:
      the column headers, or an empty array if the report is unknown
      See Also:
      • reportSql(String)

    • reportSql

      private static String reportSql(String report)
      Gets the SQL query for a report. Each query takes two timestamp parameters: the start of the range (inclusive) and the end (exclusive), except the Restock Report, which shows current stock and takes none.
      Parameters:
      report - a report name from REPORT_NAMES
      Returns:
      the SQL query, or null if the report is unknown
      See Also:
      • reportColumns(String)

    • queryParams

      private static DefaultTableModel queryParams(String sql, String[] columns, Object... params) throws SQLException
      Runs a parameterized SQL query and loads every result row into a read-only table model.
      Parameters:
      sql - the SELECT statement to execute, with ? placeholders
      columns - the column headers for the returned table
      params - the values for the placeholders, in order
      Returns:
      a table model holding one row per result row
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the query fails

    • inventoryFields

      private static JPanel inventoryFields(JTextField name, JTextField cost, JTextField unit, JTextField quantity, JTextField minimum)
      Creates a panel containing the input fields for an inventory item. The fields are arranged as labeled name, cost, unit, quantity, and restock minimum
      Parameters:
      name - the text field for the inventory item's name
      cost - the text field for the inventory item's cost
      unit - the text field for the inventory item's unit of measure
      quantity - the text field for the quantity of the inventory item
      minimum - the text field for the stock level below which the item needs restocking
      Returns:
      a panel containing the labeled inventory input fields
